entries.en: Owyne would like to speak with you regarding the sultana's invitation.
entries.fr: Owyne aimerait vous parler au sujet de l'invitation de la Sultane.
entries.ja: 銀冑団本部のオワインは、冒険者に伝えたいことがあるようだ。
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests

entries.en: Owyne states that there are certain protocols that must be observed by guests attending a royal banquet. He directs you to speak with Momodi, who will explain precisely what is expected of you.
entries.fr: Votre invitation au banquet royal a impressionné Owyne. D'après lui, vous dînerez en compagnie des hommes et des femmes les plus influents de la ville. Il vous a recommandé de parler avec Momodi pour obtenir des informations supplémentaires sur le déroulement du festin.
entries.ja: 女王ナナモからじきじきに晩餐会へ招待された冒険者。晩餐会に出席するためには、なにか必要なものがあるようだ。クイックサンドの「モモディ」に相談してみよう。
entries.frMacro: Votre invitation au banquet royal a im<->pres<->sion<->né Owyne. D'après lui, vous dînerez en compagnie des hommes et des femmes les plus influents de la ville. Il vous a recommandé de parler avec Momodi pour obtenir des in<->for<->ma<->tions sup<->plé<->men<->tai<->res sur le déroulement du festin.
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests

entries.en: According to Momodi, all who attend the royal banquet are obliged to wear a pair of ceremonial earrings. She instructs you to visit the Goldsmiths' Guild and speak with Serendipity to obtain yours.
entries.fr: Pour pouvoir participer au banquet de la Sultane, il vous faut porter un bijou particulier. C'est la guilde des orfèvres qui est chargée de sa fabrication. Allez chercher le vôtre auprès de Serendipity, le maître de guilde.
entries.ja: 晩餐会に出席するには、王室から下賜される装飾品を身に着ける必要があるらしい。モモディによれば、装飾品の製作は彫金師ギルドが担っているそうだ。彫金師ギルドの「セレンディピティー」に会い、装飾品を受け取ろう。
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests

entries.en: Serendipity presents you with a very beautiful and very locked rosewood box. For reasons of royal security, she explains, the earring cases are intended to be opened only by designated individuals. In this instance, the designated individual is apparently Momodi. Return to the Quicksand, hand over the box, and she will do the rest.

entries.fr: Serendipity vous a remis une boîte en palissandre. Allez la montrer à Momodi.

entries.en: Seats at these banquets are offered only to the most distinguished individuals. You will be dining with some of the most influential people in Ul'dah.
entries.fr: Les places à ces banquets sont généralement réservées aux citoyens les plus éminents d'Ul'dah. Vous dînerez avec les personnes les plus influentes de la cité.

entries.en: In accordance with ancient custom, all guests to this banquet are required to wear a pair of ceremonial earrin's, made 'specially for the occasion. They're meant to symbolize─ Actually, forget about that. This was meant to be the short version. Ahem. Bein' of a design unique to the occasion, the earrin's serve as a security measure. The Sultansworn won't let you near the hall without 'em.
entries.fr: Malgré la présence de la garde, les gens vont et viennent dans le palais plus facilement que d'habitude. C'est pourquoi cette coutume a été instaurée, pour éviter que des assassins ne se mêlent à la foule des invités.

王宮に侵入するのを防ぐためでもあるわ。

entries.en: In case Mistress Momodi didn't warn you, the box is locked, and I am not permitted to give you the key. It's a final safeguard, you see─only designated individuals are authorized to distribute the earrings to guests. In this instance, the person in question is none other than Mistress Momodi, so you will need to ask her to open the box on your behalf. Pardon the inconvenience, but the Sultansworn take Her Grace's safety very seriously.
